title: Happy Number - Solution
approach: Trace digital squares sum; exit with False if sum repeats.
intuition: Determine if a number n is happy. A happy number is defined by a process of replacing the number by the sum of squares of its digits repeatedly until it reaches 1.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
